about: Held-out pairs for the claim-stance rules, round 2. Written after the rules were changed in response to round 1 and before they were ever run on these; the rules have not been adjusted to them since. The score on this file is the honest estimate; the scores on stance_benchmark.json and stance_heldout_round1.json are not, because the rules were developed against those. It includes reworded passages and constructions the rules are known not to model, on purpose. Do not tune the rules to these items: if the rules change because of them, this file becomes development data and a new held-out round has to be written. Labels follow stance_benchmark.json; a passage that names someone or something else in the claim's place is 'mentions', because whether it contradicts depends on knowing that only one answer is possible.
